technical-data.invention-title: IMPROVEMENT IN THE ARRANGEMENT FOR THE INSERTION OF COILS IN A STATOR
AMELIORATION APPORTEE A UN DISPOSITIF POUR L'INSERTION DE BOBINES DANS UN STATOR

nplcit.text: PATENT ABSTRACTS OF JAPAN vol. 010, no. 293 (E-443), 4 October 1986 (1986-10-04) & JP 61 109442 A (HITACHI LTD), 27 May 1986 (1986-05-27)

abstract.p: Arrangement for the insertion of coils in a stator comprising a moving wire-insertion spider, a plurality of parallel wire-guide blades arranged along the contour of said moving spider, a stack-guide member provided with a plurality of recesses accomodating respective blades which are provided with a groove on their outer surface. Said recesses are provided with a rib protruding towards the interior of the respective recess and extending parallelly to the longitudinal direction thereof, and are adapted to engage respective grooves when the stack-guide member is inserted within said wire-guide blades. In a preferred manner, said grooves are arranged in pairs on a respective blade and are symmetrical with respect to a vertical plane passing through the axis of said moving spider.

L'invention concerne un dispositif pour l'insertion de bobines dans un stator, comportant une araignée mobile d'insertion de câble, une pluralité de lamelles parallèles de guidage de câble disposées le long du contour de ladite araignée mobile, un élément de guidage d'empilement pourvu d'une pluralité d'évidements recevant les lamelles respectives qui sont munies d'une rainure sur leur surface extérieure. Lesdits évidements sont dotés d'une nervure faisant saillie vers l'intérieur de l'évidement respectif et s'étendant parallèlement à son axe longitudinal, et sont adaptés pour venir en prise avec les rainures respectives lorsque lesdites lamelles de guidage de câble sont insérées dans l'élément de guidage d'empilement. Dans un mode préféré de réalisation, lesdites rainures sont disposées par paires sur une lamelle respective et sont symétriques par rapport à un plan vertical passant par l'axe de ladite araignée mobile.

The blade stack guide is a cylindrical member formed by a rigid central body, usually of metal, whose side surface is provided with a plurality of recesses that are spaced out regularly from each other, these recesses have an elongated shape, are open on the side surface of said cylindrical body, and are arranged m such a manner as to enable their inner surface, which is in the form of a ruled surface, to emerge, le come out at the bases of said cylmdncal body In pi ctice, this blade stack guide is fully similar to the cylmdiical body that has been described m connection with both the moving spider and the stationary blade container

It is exactly during this opei ation that, owing to the effect of the vanous combined forces and reactions, the blades can be noticed to be stressed into flexing, both outwardly and inwardly, and even into twisting

Since these blades are provided, on then outwards facing edges, with two sharp corners, that we shall call "slot lining protection borders" here and have the task of fitting in between the inlet edges of the sheath (also called "slot lining") used to protect the slot, it cleaily ensues that even these piotective borders undeigo said Uexural and/oi torsional sti esses, le m pailicular against the wires of the adjacent wne coils

Such an anchorage is cieated by both a particulai shape oi configuration of the hollow, le lnnei suiface of said lecesses and a conesponding shape or configm ation of the outer suiface of each single blade, so that these elements aie capable of engaging each other and, owing to the blade stack guide being a solid and rigid cylmdei , it ensues that both the stationaiy and moving blades, by engaging, albeit slidably, the lespective lecesses of said blade stack guide, are totally pi evented fiom flexing and twisting, thereby reaching the desired aim
